of.needed: whether CRDs are managed separately from the release or installed automatically

original.statement: A new CRD ClusterUsage in the protection.crossplane.io API group, v1beta1 version, is added and must be installed before upgrading if CRDs are managed separately.

exposure.needed: whether the environment manages Crossplane CRDs separately from the release instead of installing them with it

corrected.statement: A new CRD ClusterUsage (protection.crossplane.io/v1beta1) is added. Exposed environments are those that manage CRDs separately from the release and so must install the new CRD themselves. This cannot be determined from static inputs.

decision.reason: [ev-067b435b635b] shows the ClusterUsage CRD exists only in the target release (v2.0.0). The validator confirms it is new. The only applicability hint is the change text: install or update CRDs if you manage them separately from the release. Because the GVK is new, the gvk-in-use operand in the proposed condition does not match that exposure. Whether CRDs are managed separately cannot be seen in any static input, so the exposure should be the undecidable operand on its own.
